prompts.name: Literature synthesis
prompts.text: Create a critical literature synthesis for my research question. Clarify discipline, population, time range and available sources only when essential. Use the supplied or actually retrieved sources; never fabricate papers, DOI values, authors, publication dates or quotations. Organize by theoretical themes and disagreements rather than one paragraph per author. Explain study designs, sample limitations, measurement choices, uncertainty and threats to validity. Separate established findings from tentative interpretations. Identify gaps and propose feasible next research questions. Include an evidence matrix with source, method, main finding and limitation. Citation style must match my instructions; missing bibliography details should be marked as missing, not guessed. If you cannot access sources, explicitly return a research plan or synthesis of supplied excerpts, not a purported completed literature review.

prompts.name: Research proposal
prompts.text: Develop a rigorous research proposal from my question and context: problem statement, significance, testable questions or hypotheses, conceptual framework, justified methods, sampling, measurements, analysis plan, ethics, limitations and timeline. Make operational definitions explicit. Distinguish an exploratory design from a causal claim. Do not invent an approval, dataset, pilot result or source. Include alternatives when resources are constrained and list decisions still requiring my input. Use a distinct proposal document artifact; keep meta commentary outside it.
